desc:
This is Bakublox!

Updates come out regularly from QOL updates to suggestions from the players! Battle your friends, enemies, and competition! Collect powerful Bakublox, and battle your way to the top! 

How to Play:

Collect and unlock powerful Bakublox

Build your deck with Gate Cards and Ability Cards

Use strategic cards to outsmart your opponents

Level up your Bakublox to become stronger

Battle other players and climb the ranks

Discover new Bakublox and build your ultimate team!

Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players

You can submit bugs whenever you see any in-game.
